situation.headline: Chinese satellite intelligence linked to Iranian strike killing US troops converges with active Saudi Arabia energy infrastructure attacks and Houthi Marib offensive, creating a multi-vector crisis threatening US credibility, alliance architecture, and global oil supply simultaneously

domains.name: Middle East
domains.label: regional escalation 90d
domains.status: Full-spectrum escalation underway: Houthis launching Marib offensive and striking Saudi RSAF bases and East-West pipeline simultaneously while Iranian-backed Iraqi militias hit Saudi energy infrastructure, creating a coordinated multi-front pressure campaign that CENTCOM Commander's Riyadh visit and 99-vessel blockade redirection suggest Washington views as a managed crisis rather than an emergency.

domains.name: Indo-Pacific
domains.label: China coercion escalation
domains.status: Beijing's provision of high-resolution satellite imagery used in the July 17 strike killing three US soldiers represents a qualitative escalation in Chinese material support for Iranian offensive operations against US forces, raising the threshold question of whether this constitutes an act of war by proxy and demanding a proportional deterrent response.

domains.name: Europe
domains.label: NATO cohesion fracture
domains.status: BRICS summit hosted by India with Russian attendance signals continued non-Western alignment pressure on NATO periphery, while AfD deportation-at-gunpoint rhetoric and Swedish hard-right electoral surge indicate rightward domestic political drift in key European states, but no acute NATO fracture catalyst is imminent.

domains.name: Energy
domains.label: supply shock 60d
domains.status: Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown removes roughly 7 million barrels per day of Hormuz-bypass capacity at the exact moment oil is trading above $100, Saudi production is at a 36-year low due to ongoing conflict, and the US-Iran maritime blockade is redirecting 99 vessels, creating converging supply disruption vectors with near-term price shock probability well above baseline.

domains.name: US Politics
domains.label: House flip Nov 2026
domains.status: Prediction market pricing at 81% Democrat House takeover and 51% Senate flip aligns with 33% Trump approval polling, signaling a potential lame-duck dynamic by early 2027 that would constrain executive war powers precisely when Middle East crisis management requires maximum executive flexibility.

situation.unseen: The Chinese satellite-to-Iran intelligence pipeline is the linchpin connecting four domains that analysts are treating separately: Beijing is functionally co-belligerent in a conflict killing US troops, yet Washington's public response is muted, likely because confronting China directly over the July 17 strike risks collapsing the broader US-China trade stabilization framework and would land during a domestic political environment where Trump's 33% approval makes a two-front escalation electorally catastrophic, meaning Beijing has correctly calculated the price of its proxy contribution is near-zero, incentivizing further such support.
situation.criticalWindow: The Houthi Marib offensive is the most time-sensitive decision point: Marib's fall would give Ansar Allah control of Yemen's primary hydrocarbon-producing region, providing independent revenue to sustain operations indefinitely, eliminat the Saudi-backed IRG's last major eastern stronghold, and fundamentally alter the negotiating geometry of any ceasefire, all within a 30-60 day window given the Emergency Forces' visible evacuation preparations and the Central Bank withdrawal already underway.
watchFor: US or Israeli kinetic response to the Chinese satellite-Iran intelligence link, which would signal a decision to escalate horizontally and carry extreme escalation risk
Marib city falling to Ansar Allah, which would trigger Saudi direct military intervention calculus and remove the last leverage point for a negotiated Yemen settlement

Saudi East-West pipeline remaining offline beyond 72 hours, which combined with sub-100 US oil rig counts and $100-plus crude would push Brent toward price levels historically associated with global recession

Zelenskyy-Putin meeting contract spiking 7 cents in 24 hours to 17% alongside the trilateral contract jumping 5 cents, suggesting backchannels are active and a sudden Ukraine deal could release Russian pressure toward the Middle East theater
situation.confidenceNote: Key uncertainties include the actual operational relationship between Chinese entities and IRGC targeting cells (commercial imagery sale versus deliberate intelligence sharing carries vastly different escalation implications), the genuine readiness of Saudi ground forces to hold without US ISR support, whether the Houthi-Trump back-channel cited by Trump in Dublin represents a genuine off-ramp or a delay tactic, and the reliability of the 81% Democrat House probability given prediction market insider-trading warnings flagged by the EU watchdog.
situation.topPattern: A coordinated Iranian axis operation is simultaneously attacking US troops via Chinese-enabled precision strikes, Saudi energy infrastructure via Iraqi proxy drones, Saudi military bases via Houthi ballistic missiles, and Yemen's last pro-Saudi stronghold via ground offensive, while oil clears $100 and Saudi production hits a 36-year low, yet US domestic political constraints reflected in Trump's 33% approval and the 81% Democrat House takeover pricing on Kalshi are suppressing the proportional deterrent response this multi-domain assault would otherwise demand, signaling to Beijing and Tehran that the current window for cost-free aggression remains open.

signals.headline: Iranian satellite imagery linked to July 2024 drone strike on US base in Jordan
signals.summary: US officials have confirmed that high-resolution Chinese satellite imagery provided to Iran enabled the July 17 Iranian missile strike on Muwaffaq al Salti Air Base in Jordan, killing three US troops. This represents direct Chinese-Iranian military coordination against US personnel.
signals.signal: China is actively enabling Iranian strike capability against US forces. Escalation threshold has shifted—Chinese ISR infrastructure is now a direct targeting vector. Implies requirement for US response against Chinese commercial space sector or Iranian procurement networks.
signals.contradicts: Assumption that US-China strategic competition remains primarily economic/technological rather than kinetic-enablement

signals.headline: Houthi full-scale offensive captures Marib; Saudi East-West pipeline shut after Iraqi-based militia drone strikes
signals.summary: Ansar Allah launched coordinated assault on Marib while Iranian-backed militias struck Saudi Arabia's critical 7 million barrel-per-day East-West pipeline from Iraqi territory. Pipeline now offline; Yemen's central bank evacuated. Signals major loss of Saudi operational control.
signals.signal: Energy infrastructure bypass to Strait of Hormuz is now compromised. Oil markets face supply shock from dual Saudi/Houthi escalation. Trump's stated policy of non-involvement with Houthis directly contradicts military reality on ground—Houthis are coordinating with Iran's broader strike campaign.
signals.contradicts: Trump administration claim that Houthis have 'let majority of ships through' and represent manageable threat

signals.headline: 2028 Democratic nom prediction market heavily fragmented; no frontrunner—Ossoff 17%, Newsom 14%, AOC 16%
signals.summary: Kalshi markets show near-zero probability for Harris (8%), Whitmer (1%), Booker (1%), but meaningful spread across Ossoff, Newsom, AOC, and long-tail candidates Beshear (3%), Kelly (4%), Rahm Emanuel (3%). Market is pricing extreme uncertainty in Dem succession.
signals.signal: Implies Party lacks consensus heir and faces genuine internal fracture. High open interest on fringe candidates (Talarico 2%, Mamdani 0%) suggests retail/ideological betting rather than informed consensus. Democratic nominee will emerge from contested floor or brokered process, not coronation.
signals.contradicts: Conventional media narrative of clear Democratic bench strength and inevitable moderate successor

signals.headline: J.D. Vance priced at 46% Republican nom; 22% to win presidency outright
signals.summary: Kalshi markets price Vance as clear GOP frontrunner for 2028 nomination (46%), with secondary odds at 22% to win general election. Rubio secondary at 21% nom probability. Trump himself at only 2% nominee probability.
signals.signal: Markets reflect assumption Trump will not run 2028 or will be barred. Vance represents continuity of Trump coalition without Trump himself. If accurate, signals major post-Trump GOP realignment and validates Vance as viable general-election candidate in current electorate.
signals.contradicts: Trump's historical pattern of seeking rematches and media assumption of his continued dominance

signals.headline: North Korean KN-23 tactical ballistic missiles used in Zaporizhzhia strike; Russian Molniya/Orion drone production targeted by Ukraine
signals.summary: OSINT confirms North Korean missile employment in active Ukraine theater. Simultaneously, Ukrainian drones struck Russian Atlant Aero production facility for Molniya/Orion reconnaissance drones and Taganrog Airbase. Represents direct NK-Russia operational integration and Ukraine targeting drone supply chain.
signals.signal: North Korean weapons are no longer theoretical—they are in active combat rotation. Ukraine has shifted to supply-chain degradation strategy against Russian ISR capability. Implies extended conflict timeline and integration of North Korean military-industrial base into Russia's war effort.
signals.contradicts: Assumption that NK support is peripheral or symbolic

signals.headline: EU warns prediction markets 'rife with insider trading'; Kalshi sees elevated volume on fringe 2028 candidates
signals.summary: EU financial watchdog flags prediction-market manipulation risk. Simultaneously, Kalshi shows anomalous high open interest on long-tail Democratic candidates (Talarico 4M OI, Mamdani 3.8M OI, Platner 2.6M OI) with near-zero price but sustained volume.
signals.signal: High-OI fringe positions may indicate either retail enthusiasm, ideological blocs positioning, or informed bets on contested convention triggering secondary candidates. Structural vulnerability to information asymmetry in prediction markets complicates reliability for geopolitical forecasting.
signals.contradicts: Use of prediction markets as clean signal of consensus forecast

scanNote: Signal quality degraded by headline-dominated feed lacking depth; OSINT feed provides operational detail but lacks strategic assessment; prediction markets show unusual fragmentation in 2028 races suggesting genuine uncertainty rather than consensus.

markets.label: Zelensky-Putin meeting before Jan 1 2027
markets.rationale: The market spiked +7¢ to 17% today, but OSINT shows Russia escalating missile strikes on Odesa and Ukrainian drones hitting Taganrog, with no credible diplomatic channel visible; the BRICS summit context where Russia and India are present creates marginal back-channel opportunity but conditions on the ground strongly argue against a meeting materializing within this timeframe.

markets.label: Trump-Zelensky-Putin trilateral before Jan 1 2027
markets.rationale: A +5¢ spike to 5% today likely reflects the same diplomatic noise as the bilateral market, but a trilateral format is substantially harder to arrange; active Russian strikes on Ukrainian cities and no reported US shuttle diplomacy make this resolution very unlikely before the deadline.

markets.label: J.D. Vance Republican nominee 2028
markets.rationale: At 46% market price, Vance's incumbent VP status is his core asset, but Trump's 33% approval, Democratic 81% House odds, and the 'What comes after the Don' discourse all signal a weakened MAGA brand heading into 2028, moderately depressing Vance's true probability relative to current market pricing.

markets.label: Marco Rubio Republican nominee 2028
markets.rationale: Rubio at 21% market and 11% to win the general benefits from the Chinese satellite-Iran strike intelligence story, which would elevate his foreign-policy credentials as Secretary of State, but the Republican field dynamics remain highly uncertain with Trump's approval collapse reshaping the race.

markets.label: Jon Ossoff Democratic nominee 2028
markets.rationale: At 17% Ossoff is priced as a frontrunner, but AOC at 16% and Newsom at 14% are close competitors; the fragmented Democratic field with no dominant figure, combined with Dems riding a strong midterm wave, makes this a wide-open race and Ossoff's probability is modestly discounted from market price given his lower national profile.

markets.label: Gavin Newsom Democratic nominee 2028
markets.rationale: Newsom ticked up +1¢ today; Democratic midterm strength implied by 81% House odds creates a favorable environment for prominent Dem governors, but California coastal erosion festival cancellations and broader climate optics may cut both ways for Newsom's national appeal.

markets.label: Ulf Kristersson becomes Swedish PM after 2026 election
markets.rationale: The market dropped -3¢ to 27% as headlines note a close race with the hard right eyeing a government role; Kristersson leading a right-wing coalition is plausible but the AfD-style 'deportation at gunpoint' rhetoric from Sweden's far right could energize left opposition and keep the race genuinely competitive.

markets.label: US recession in 2027
markets.rationale: Oil topping $100 with Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline offline and production at a 36-year low, combined with an active US-Iran war per GDELT energy sources and ongoing NVIDIA-Anthropic mega-IPO speculation suggesting late-cycle asset inflation, collectively point to elevated but not dominant recession risk for 2027, roughly in line with the market's 23% but slightly higher given energy shock severity.

watchSignals: Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline shutdown and cascading attacks on critical energy infrastructure—monitor whether repairs proceed and if Iranian-backed NSAs escalate targeting of other Gulf petro-assets; oil price stability hangs on pipeline restoration timeline

Houthi full-scale Marib offensive and apparent collapse of Saudi-backed Emergency Forces defensive lines—track whether Ansar Allah consolidates control, whether Saudi airstrikes resume kinetic ops after stated non-retaliation posture, and knock-on effects on Red Sea shipping chokepoint

U.S. intelligence public confirmation that China provided high-resolution satellite imagery enabling Iranian strike on al-Salti Air Base (3 US troops KIA)—watch for U.S. retaliatory signaling toward Beijing, escalation of proxy targeting of US personnel, and Chinese response

Kalshi market moves on 2028 Democratic nominee (Newsom 14%, Ossoff 17%, AOC 16%) showing fragmentation with zero consensus frontrunner and Harris at only 8%—monitor if unified candidate emerges or if Democratic primary becomes contested proxy fight signaling party instability

McConnell three-month absence with unclear return date amid Republican congressional activity—track Senate leadership vacuum effects on legislative agenda, whether minority coordination degrades, and health-driven succession speculation

UK/EU regulatory pressure on prediction markets (EU watchdog warns of insider trading) combined with high-volume Kalshi activity—monitor if regulatory crackdowns reduce market liquidity and thus degrade real-time signal quality for intel assessment

groundTruth.headline: Saudi Arabia's critical East-West oil pipeline (7M bbl/day bypass capacity) shut down after coordinated drone strikes from Iraq; Iranian-backed militias confirmed as originator; pipeline carried ~7% of global crude supply
groundTruth.summary: The East-West pipeline shutdown removes major Hormuz bypass capacity and creates immediate upside pressure on global oil prices. Iraq deferred to Saudi investigation rather than intervening, signaling Iranian proxy freedom of action. This is first successful sustained disruption of Saudi critical infrastructure in months, raising questions about Saudi air defense efficacy.
groundTruth.signal: US faces potential crude price spike, regional escalation risk, and need to reassess Saudi military capability. Energy markets may see volatility; potential for US military posture adjustment in Gulf.

groundTruth.headline: U.S. Central Command publicly linked Chinese satellite imagery to Iranian July 17 strike on Muwaffaq al Salti Air Base in Jordan that killed 3 US troops and wounded several others
groundTruth.summary: This is explicit US attribution of Chinese intelligence support to an Iranian attack that resulted in American combat deaths. Public disclosure signals deliberate escalation messaging to Beijing and Iran. Prior communications interception and HUMINT indicated this connection; public confirmation is strategic decision.
groundTruth.signal: Strong signal that US intends to hold China accountable for dual-use ISR provision to adversaries targeting US personnel. Expect diplomatic pressure on Beijing and possible secondary sanctions. Raises stakes for China's role in Iran proxy network.

groundTruth.headline: Ansar Allah (Houthis) launched full-scale offensive on Marib; Emergency Forces (Saudi-backed) evacuating Central Bank and withdrawing toward Wadi Hadramawt; Houthis simultaneously attacked Saudi RSAF bases (King Fahd, King Khalid) and Al-Wadiah border crossing with ballistic missiles
groundTruth.summary: Coordinated multi-axis Houthi offensive targeting both Saudi rear-area infrastructure and forward defensive positions suggests operational planning beyond typical harassment. Saudi non-retaliation statement after pipeline strikes signals restraint or diplomatic-level constraints on kinetic response.
groundTruth.signal: US-backed Saudi coalition losing territorial control momentum in Yemen. If Marib falls, Houthis control major population center and strengthen negotiating posture. Implications for CENTCOM operations and regional balance. Risk of wider Iranian-proxy coordination (Iraq-Yemen-Syria nexus).

groundTruth.headline: Trump approval at 33%; prediction markets show Dem 81% chance House, 51% Senate; 2028 Dem nominee race shows fragmentation with no consensus (Ossoff 17%, Newsom 14%, AOC 16%, Kamala Harris 8%)
groundTruth.summary: Current approval rating suggests mid-term electoral headwinds for Trump administration. Democratic fragmentation in 2028 primary betting signals weak heir apparent and possible contested convention scenario. Senate control margin razor-thin per market pricing.
groundTruth.signal: Expect aggressive Democratic investigations if they take House. Policy agenda uncertainty through 2026; Republican Senate majority vulnerable to single-digit seat swings in 2026. Nomination market volatility reflects genuine uncertainty about Democratic party direction post-election.

groundTruth.headline: Ukrainian drones conducting sustained raids into Russia including successful strikes on Taganrog Airbase and Atlant Aero drone-production facility; North Korean KN-23 ballistic missiles fired into Zaporizhzhia civilian city; Russian helicopter pursuit of Ukrainian drones ongoing
groundTruth.summary: Continued Ukrainian offensive drone capability against Russian rear-area targets demonstrates asymmetric advantage persistence. NK missile integration into Russian arsenal confirms expanded theater-wide threat. Russian helicopter counter-drone activity suggests attrition pressure on both sides.
groundTruth.signal: US military aid effectiveness in drone sustainment and deep strikes validated by OSINT. NK involvement deepens Russia-DPRK military integration and raises questions about US deterrence of further escalation. Targeting of Russian drone production suggests Ukrainian strategy to degrade Russian ISR/strike pipeline.
